title: Boards
text: A board holds columns and cards. Drag a card between columns to change its status. Every plan allows unlimited boards per workspace.

title: Recurring tasks
text: Open a card, click Repeat, and choose Daily, Weekly, Monthly or Custom. Custom lets you pick an interval such as every second Friday. A new card is created when the previous one is marked done.

title: CSV export
text: Open the board menu, choose Export, then CSV. An export holds up to 10,000 cards. Exports of more than 2,000 cards are emailed as a download link that expires after 24 hours. CSV is the only export format.

title: Slack integration
text: Install the Tasklane app from the Slack App Directory, then run /tasklane connect in a channel and pick a board. New cards and comments are posted to the channel. Only workspace admins can connect channels.

title: Single sign-on
text: SAML SSO is available on the Business plan only. Supported providers are Okta, Azure AD and Google Workspace. Admins set it up under Settings > Security > SSO. Once SSO is on, password login is disabled for everyone except the workspace owner.

title: Guests
text: Invite a guest to a single board by email. Guests can comment and move cards but cannot create boards. The Team plan includes up to 5 free guests per workspace. Beyond that, each guest counts as a paid seat.

title: Pricing
text: The Team plan costs $8 per seat per month billed monthly, or $6 per seat per month billed annually. The Business plan costs $15 per seat per month and includes SSO and the audit log. Enterprise requires contacting sales.

title: Refunds
text: Refunds are available within 14 days of a charge. Annual plans are refunded pro rata only within 30 days of purchase. Send requests to billing@tasklane.example.

title: API tokens
text: Create a personal API token under Profile > Developer. A token has the permissions of the user who created it and expires after 90 days by default. The rate limit is 60 requests per minute per token.

title: Archived cards
text: Archived cards are kept for 60 days. Restore them from the board menu under Archived items. After 60 days they are deleted permanently.

title: Board templates
text: Save any board as a template from the board menu with Save as template. A template keeps columns, labels and recurring rules. It does not keep assignees or comments.

title: Two-factor authentication
text: Turn on two-factor authentication under Profile > Security, using an authenticator app. SMS codes are not supported. If you lose your device, use one of the 10 recovery codes shown during setup.

title: Data and compliance
text: EU workspaces store data in AWS eu-central-1 (Frankfurt). Other workspaces use us-east-1. Data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.2 or newer. The SOC 2 Type II report is available to Business customers under NDA.

title: Keyboard shortcuts
text: Press N to add a card, F to focus search, and ? to list all shortcuts. Shortcuts cannot be remapped.

title: Audit log
text: The audit log is available on the Business plan. It keeps 12 months of events and can be exported as CSV.
